description: Lists every payout rail BlindPay supports (ACH, domestic wire, RTP, PIX, SPEI, SEPA, SWIFT, and more) as `{ label, value, country }`. Pass `value` as the `rail` query parameter of `GET /v1/available/bank-details`, and as the `type` when creating a bank account. `country` is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 flag hint for display, not a statement of coverage. Public: no API key required.
name: GetV1AvailableRails
title: Get Available Rails
